items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: Jimmy -- Jimmy Harris, oh he used to come through there with Fletcher before.

ctx.x: And he used to get loaded; that thing would turn around backwards and just look all kind of funny ways. And Rex Stewart was playing in -- I first heard Rex before he was with Duke. Rex was with Fletcher, I think, when I first heard him, before he was with Duke, and Rex used to come through there a lot, and a lot of name musicians -- lot of good trombone players used to come through there.

Jimmy -- Jimmy Harris, oh he used to come through there with Fletcher before. Coleman Hawkins, of course, was with Fletcher in those days when they'd come through, and they were all -- they were all young then. They're pretty young now.
